Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert made an error by relying on information from Genius.com instead of using the Wikipedia source. This led to the inclusion of "Cantora," "Cantora 2," and "Cantora 1" as separate albums, even though "Cantora" is often considered a single project released in two parts. The task specifically required using the latest 2022 version of English Wikipedia, and the deviation from this source likely resulted in the incorrect count of five albums instead of the correct count of three.
